title: docs(skills): objectstack-i18n teaches i18n.sourceLocale

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XvDBw73kUzCQbvPjg5vDdt)_

Fixes #33635

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-i18n` 技能的 `i18n` 键表新增 `sourceLocale` 一行(内联 `label:` 文本的语言,缺省即 `defaultLocale`),并写明英文编写、中文用户的配法和 `fallbackLocale` 的服务端注意事项;`--default-locale` 的说明改为"覆盖源语言"。
- 为什么改:技能只教 `defaultLocale`,AI 给"英文写、卖给中国用户"的应用会写 `defaultLocale: 'en'`,丢掉用户默认语言,或得到大量误报的"缺 en"。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档 + 一条评测用例,不动运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 键表下方新增的四行(服务端注意事项一句)、`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` 的第 11 条用例。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 i18n 行显示 `6146 / 6333` 且全绿。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (published, English):

- **Key table:** a `sourceLocale` row (optional, defaults to `defaultLocale`; the language inline `label:` text is written in; read by `os lint`, `os i18n check`, `os i18n extract`). The `defaultLocale` row now says what it is: the locale a user who has not chosen one gets.
- **Under the table (4 lines):** an English-authored app for Chinese users declares `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN', sourceLocale: 'en'`, not an English `defaultLocale` (the warning does not spell the literal the eval refuses). The serving caveat as the spec change published it: label serving still reads inline text as `defaultLocale` text, so without `fallbackLocale: 'en'` an `en` request reaches the zh-CN bundle before the English inline label. The serving card (#33634) is still open, so the caveat names no future behaviour. One clause names the refused near-miss spellings `sourceLanguage` / `authoringLocale` / `authoringLanguage`.
- **Translation Coverage:** "Gaps in the default locale are errors" now says source locale. That is the locale `computeI18nCoverage` raises errors against (`resolveSourceLocale`).
- **Extract Skeletons:** the source locale (not "the default locale") is filled from schema labels. `--default-locale` overrides the source locale for one run (`i18n.sourceLocale`, else `i18n.defaultLocale`, else `en`). It moved out of the trailing flag list into that sentence, so the list no longer repeats it.

Every taught fact is read from origin/main: `TranslationConfigSchema.sourceLocale` and its `aliases` in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`; `resolveSourceLocale` / `withGatedDefaultLocale` in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`; the `--default-locale` help in `packages/cli/src/commands/{lint,i18n/check,i18n/extract}.ts`.

`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`: case 11 (English-authored app, Chinese users by default). It must contain `sourceLocale`, `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, `fallbackLocale: 'en'` and `supportedLocales`, and must not contain `defaultLocale: 'en'` or `sourceLocale: 'zh-CN'`, shapes only a wrong (English-default or role-swapped) config writes. It is self-consistent: no `must_not_contain` string occurs in its own `expected_output` or in the skill passages a correct answer quotes (the only SKILL.md hits are the two English-default config examples). Spliced with the file's hand formatting kept.

`.changeset/33635-i18n-source-locale-skill.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Tests

No code changed, so there is nothing to ablate. Gate readings are below under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Build tier, declared:** `dispatch-gates --tier` puts `skills/**` at the contract-review tier (clause ①, no one-line exit). This card thread is served at the default build tier and cannot switch its own model. With the seat's consent, the authoring (all three files and the commit) ran in an isolated os-dev subagent pinned to the contract-review tier inside this worktree. The relay writes, gates and report ran in the thread.
- **Not taught, on purpose:** "`sourceLocale` need not appear in `supportedLocales`" and "with `sourceLocale` declared, `defaultLocale` is gated and scaffolded even when `supportedLocales` omits it". Both are true on main. They did not fit the +6-line budget, and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` carries both.
- The config example at the top of the skill keeps `defaultLocale: 'en'`, which is correct for an English-default app.
